verses.gurmukhi: ਮਖਣੁ ਲਇਆ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਕੈ ਛਾਹਿ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: makhan liaa virolikai chhaeh chhuTaR hoiee|

en.bdb: When the butter is churned and taken away, the butter milk (lassi) is abandoned.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀੜ ਲਈ ਰਸੁ ਗੰਨਿਅਹੁਂ ਛਿਲੁ ਛੁਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: peeR liee ras ga(n)niahu(n) chhil chhuhai na koiee|

en.bdb: When the juice of sugarcane is extracted out, nobody touches the bagasse.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਅਢੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g majeeThahu nikalai add lahai na soiee|

en.bdb: When the fast colour of Rubia munjista is taken away then nobody cares for it even worth a penny.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈ ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀਅਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: vaas liee fulavaaReeahu fir milai na ddoiee|

en.bdb: When the fragrance of flowers is exhausted, no more shelter they get.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਥੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: kaiaa ha(n)s vichhu(n)niaa tis ko na sathoiee|

en.bdb: When the atman separates from the body, no companion of the body remains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਸੁਕੇ ਰੁਖ ਜਿਉਂ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh suke rukh jiau(n) vekhai sabh loiee ||12||

en.bdb: It is clear to everyone that the apostate is like drywood (which can only be pushed into fire).
